title: TaskFlow
tagline: Manage your day, one task at a time.
summary: A task manager with per-user accounts, priorities, deadlines with times, overdue detection and a clean dark interface, deployed with PostgreSQL.
problem: A simple product done properly: user isolation, deadlines, priorities and a real production deployment.
note: Free hosting: the first load can take about 30 seconds.
features: Register, log in and only ever see your own tasks
Low, medium and high priorities with badges
Deadlines with an exact time, and overdue highlighting
Search and filter by keyword, status, priority and overdue
A live dashboard with clickable stat cards
A time trail: created, updated and completed
why: A simple product done properly. TaskFlow shows a complete, production-ready Django workflow, from local development to a live deployment with PostgreSQL, user isolation, deadlines and priorities.
hard: Every task belongs to one account and every query is scoped to it.
Gunicorn, Whitenoise, HSTS and a one-file Render blueprint.
